name: Voice log
description:
Posts everything OzBot says in voice to a channel: the quote, which voice said it, and the audio clip.
It also notes when OzBot joins and leaves a call.

settings.label: Post to channel
settings.help: OzBot needs Send Messages and Attach Files there.

settings.label: Message format
settings.help: {text} = what was said, {voice} = voice name, {user} = who asked (no ping), {source} = random line, /speak, /say…

settings.label: Attach the audio clip
settings.help: MP3, plays inline in Discord. Nothing is kept on the server.

settings.label: Join / leave notes
settings.help: “🔊 Joined TheRoundTable” and “👋 Left after 1 h 20 min, said 14 lines”.
